 "data": "sequenceDiagram
 participant C as Container 172.18.0.2
 participant H as EC2 host
 participant G as VPC internet gateway
 participant I as Internet server
 C->>H: Packet via gateway 172.18.0.1
 Note over H: POSTROUTING MASQUERADE changes source to EC2 private IPv4
 H->>G: Packet with EC2 private source address
 Note over G: AWS translates EC2 private IPv4 to its public IPv4
 G->>I: Packet with EC2 public source address
 I-->>G: Reply to EC2 public IPv4
 G-->>H: Reply translated to EC2 private IPv4
 Note over H: Conntrack reverses the container SNAT mapping
 H-->>C: Reply delivered through capsule0 and the veth pair",
 "config": null,
 "version": "12"
